text: 9月16日，国务院台办举行例行新闻发布会。总台记者提问：台媒报道，台行政部门通过的2027年度防务预算与特别预算占GDP接近4%，萧美琴重提赖清德允诺会将防务支出提升至GDP的5%。请问对此有何评论？
text_en: On September 16, the Taiwan Affairs Office of the State Council held a regular press conference. A CCTV reporter asked: Taiwan media reported that the 2027 defense budget and special budget passed by the Taiwan administrative authorities account for nearly 4% of GDP, and Hsiao Bi-khim again mentioned Lai Ching-te's promise to raise defense spending to 5% of GDP. What is your comment on this?
